title: Motion light
summary: Read a PIR motion sensor and switch a light.
goal: The LED on pin 13 is on exactly while the PIR sensor on pin 2 reports motion.
brief:
A PIR (passive infrared) sensor drives its output **HIGH** while it sees movement. It is wired to **digital pin 2**.

1. Make pin 2 an `INPUT` and pin 13 an `OUTPUT`.
2. In `loop()`, read pin 2 with `digitalRead`.
3. If it is `HIGH`, turn the LED on, otherwise turn it off.

The check walks in front of the sensor at 1.5 s and walks away at 3 s.
hints: You need to read the sensor every time loop() runs, not just once in setup().
int motion = digitalRead(PIR_PIN); gives HIGH or LOW. Compare it in an if.
if (digitalRead(PIR_PIN) == HIGH) { digitalWrite(LED_PIN, HIGH); } else { digitalWrite(LED_PIN, LOW); }
